summary: South Tower lookout site in Todd County on the Rosebud Indian Reservation; the FFLA lists it as gone, while firelookout.com gives status as unknown.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; firelookout.com gives the status as unknown.

evidence.supports: Todd County on Rosebud Indian Reservation
agency listed as Rosebud Indian Reservation
North Tower in Todd County marked gone
reservation boundary includes all of Todd County, so the site lies inside it
evidence.quote: The Rosebud Indian Reservation is located in south central South Dakota. It includes within its recognized border all of Todd County

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The FFLA list says Tower Gone; firelookout.com says Unknown. The story reports both and keeps the brief's gone status, with low confidence.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence: the Forest Lookouts page has only a header, and firelookout.com has a location block and no history. No build, staffing, fire or removal record was found, so none is written. The brief's access 'permission' and its note 'Ask the tribe before visiting' do not appear on any page read, so no access facts were written; the reservation boundary (Wikipedia) supports only that the site lies inside it, not who owns the land. The brief's status 'gone' rests on the FFLA list alone. Confirm the status and access with a human reviewer or the tribe before publishing.
